authorization.source: Latest user message in this conversation
authorization.text: Please continue all work that remains incomplete with approval for the path forward and application scope and acceptance budgets.
authorization.meaning: Delegation to select scope and budgets; not independent scientific or maintainer approval.

application.use: Reproducible idealized regional auroral-response experiments and numerical method development before model integration
application.primary_workload: Pinned mini2dns_fang and mini3d_fang inputs, 300 simulated seconds; strict complete 60-second electric and precipitation drivers; additional shifted-midnight copy for calendar tests
application.epoch: 20-21 February 2013 benchmark epoch; future 2026-2030 applications remain blocked on R03
application.geometry: Existing pinned Cartesian auroral grids; no claim of IGRF field alignment
application.platform: Linux x86-64, GNU Fortran 13.2/GCC 13.3, OpenMPI 4.1.6, one node, 1 and 2 ranks; HDF5 2.2.0 current and 1.10.10 compatibility
application.policy: Strict coverage, stop on invalid CFL, no imputation or automatic retry; offline research use, no operational forecast or physical control

native_references.policy: Unchanged pinned archives and existing field tolerances; zero failed, skipped or unlaunched required tests

forcing.schema: Explicit efield or precip, disk ordering latitude x longitude; scalar categorical BC flag

checkpoint.norm: RMS difference <= absolute_floor + 1e-10 * RMS continuous field; each species independently; all output frames after restart
checkpoint.atomicity: Final .h5 name visible only after HDF5 close and successful same-directory rename; interruption leaves prior final file intact
checkpoint.rationale: A deterministic same-build, same-layout continuation should agree within accumulated float64 roundoff. These bounds are intentionally tighter than the previously measured drift.

advection_balance.rationale: Conservative flux differencing must telescope to a floating-point summation budget, independent of physical model accuracy.

research_physical_targets.status: Future held-out matched-regime physical-validation targets; not measured or claimed for the idealized numerical benchmark
research_physical_targets.rationale: Explicit initial research targets, to be assessed alongside instrument uncertainty and representativeness; no alteration after looking at held-out results without a versioned requalification.

performance.workload: 300-second mini3d_fang, 2 ranks, current workspace CPU allocation, complete I/O
performance.claim: Local bounded batch workload only; three repetitions do not establish a production tail percentile

ion_continuity.norm: For each ion species, delta-number minus applied chemical/ionization increment plus actual numerical face transport minus cleanup increment, scaled by largest state/source/transport/cleanup integral. Electron quasi-neutrality checked separately.
ion_continuity.rationale: Same roundoff accounting budget as the split flux check, declared before the first native full-step continuity measurement. This does not validate chemical-rate physics.

non_claims: Original R01-R18 program gates are preserved; this stage does not close independent physics review, hosted CI or integration work by reclassification.
Numerical regression and synthetic observations are not independent physical validation.
